description: SECURITY (s441, S440 F4). A helper declared inside a server function wraps scrml:auth `verifyPassword`, so the compiler emits it `async`. It is handed to a user-written higher-order function (`drive(matches)`), which calls it and tests the result. That result is an unawaited Promise — always truthy — so before s441 `check` answered "accepted" for EVERY password (reproduced with real hashing) and compiled clean. Ruled S440 (F4): an async-colored function may not escape as a value; only the awaited collection methods may take it. The pass now fails closed with E-ASYNC-FN-ESCAPES-AS-VALUE and not with a sync-callback code (nothing here is a collection callback).
rationale: §13.2: an async-colored function (one the compiler emits `async`: a server function, a Promise-returning stdlib function, or a helper that calls one) SHALL NOT be used as a value; passing it to a function that is not an awaited collection method SHALL be a compile error (E-ASYNC-FN-ESCAPES-AS-VALUE, §34).
